title: Symbol Synchronizer
text: 校正符号定时时钟偏移，输入 1 路、输出 2 路；按 {Timing error detector} 指定定时误差检测器类型 Zero-Crossing；{Modulation type} 指定调制类型 PAM/PSK/QAM、{Samples per symbol} 指定每符号样本数、{Damping factor} 指定环路滤波器的阻尼因子、{Normalized loop bandwidth} 指定环路滤波器的归一化带宽、{Detector gain} 指定相位检测器增益、{Normalized timing error output port} 启用归一化定时误差输出端口、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Code，按实例取值。

ports.name: Samp
ports.summary: 输入样本 scalar (default) | column vector

ports.name: Sym
ports.summary: 输出信号符号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Err
ports.summary: 估计定时误差 scalar | column vector

params.name: Timing error detector
params.values: 定时误差检测器类型 Zero-Crossing (decision-directed) (default) | Gardner (non-data-aided) | Early-Late (non-data-aided) | Mueller-Muller (decision-directed)

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: 每符号样本数 2 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: Damping factor
params.values: 环路滤波器的阻尼因子 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Normalized loop bandwidth
params.values: 环路滤波器的归一化带宽 0.01 (default) | positive scalar less than 1

params.name: Detector gain
params.values: 相位检测器增益 2.7 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Normalized timing error output port
params.values: 启用归一化定时误差输出端口 on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
